core_obligations: Describe Rf_! as Rfbar_* o Rj_! for a compactification and use cofilteredness to compare two compactifications by a morphism between them (proof lines 8700-8718).
proof_roadmap: The cofiltered category of compactifications and the comparison isomorphism (proof lines 8700-8718).
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that the functor Rf_! is, up to isomorphism, independent of the choice of the compactification, and the surrounding text records that it will be characterised as a left adjoint to f^!, which determines it up to unique isomorphism (statement lines 8687-8718). The proof considers the category of compactifications of X over Y, which is cofiltered by More on Flatness, Theorem labelled flat-theorem-nagata together with Lemmas labelled flat-lemma-compactifications-cofiltered and flat-lemma-compactifyable, and notes that each compactification j : X -> Xbar with fbar : Xbar -> Y gives the functor Rfbar_* o Rj_! (proof lines 8700-8708). For a morphism g : Xbar_1 -> Xbar_2 of compactifications over Y one has the isomorphism Rfbar_{2,*} o Rj_{2,!} = Rfbar_{2,*} o Rg_* o j_{1,!} = Rfbar_{1,*} o Rj_{1,!}, the first equality by Lemma labelled lemma-well-defined, which shows that the functor is independent of the choice up to isomorphism (proof lines 8708-8718). Using cofilteredness to compare any two compactifications through a morphism between them is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
